source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves sIDP soundness and COPAG completeness for unconditional selected interventional kernels, presents sCIDP for conditional kernels, and explicitly leaves sCIDP completeness and a conditional hedge analogue to future work.
The paper studies S-ID in a known augmented ADMG with latent variables, gives a sufficient graphical condition and sound algorithm, and states that completeness is conjectured.
The proceedings paper develops a conditional-effect identification algorithm for PAGs and proves it sound and complete in the no-selection setting.

Add a fully worked four-vertex all-fail COPAG instance that records its reachable role graph, each failed terminal sIDP call, and a denominator-locked certificate or a documented obstruction to one.

State a separate theorem that the formula-or-certificate synthesis bound is conditional exactly on a constructive version of the extraction OEQ, with an explicit encoding for latent cardinalities and rational-table output size.
